notes: Piel's two attested forms show two genuinely distinct, independently cited senses, not synonyms of one sense -- Isa.48.13 (טִפְּחָה, "my right hand spread out the heavens") and Lam.2.22 (טִפַּחְתִּי, "those whom I have nursed/reared [my enemy has destroyed]", of children). Both are the same code+category as each other's paradigm slot only in the loose sense of both being 'perfect' -- they are different persons (3fs vs. 1cs) and don't compete for the same slot, but the schema has no way to gloss two different codes within one category differently (form_glosses only keys by category), so both senses are folded into one compound root-level gloss per the two-or-more-genuinely-distinct-cited-senses rule.
